title: canonical_derivation.ipynb

canonical_node.axiom: The chi-field Lagrangian density, when varied, yields the equations of motion and conserved quantities that define the theoretical framework.
definitions: chi-field: a scalar field with Lagrangian density leading to a nonlinear Klein-Gordon equation with cubic self-interaction.
J_grace: a source term in the chi-field equation of motion, with unresolved dimensional issues.
G_eff: effective gravitational constant modified by the chi-field as G_eff = G / (1 + chi).
derivation: Section 1: The chi-field action is written in flat and curved spacetime, and the Lagrangian density is constructed.
Section 2: Euler-Lagrange equations yield chi + mchi + chi = J_grace.
Section 3: Dimensional analysis shows the naive product form fails, but the chi-field Lagrangian passes.
Section 4: The propagator residue is computed as +1, indicating no ghost modes.
Section 5: Non-relativistic limit reduces to Gross-Pitaevskii equation.
Section 6: Noether's theorem yields conserved currents and stress-energy tensor.
Section 7: Coupling to gravity modifies Einstein equations, giving G_eff = G / (1 + chi).
Section 8: Grace source term J_grace is derived, with an open dimensional issue.
Section 9: Stability analysis at chi=0 shows stable minimum for m>0, >0.
Section 10: Honest status report lists derived, asserted, and open items.
canonical_node.action: Use the chi-field Lagrangian as the foundational theoretical model, deriving predictions and constraints from its equations of motion and symmetries.
